<style>
:root{
  --ink:#eee7d8; --ink-dim:#b9c2c2;
  --deep:#081418; --deep2:#0d1f26; --panel:#0f262e;
  --teal:#4a8a8c; --teal-lt:#7fb3ac; --khaki:#b6975f; --khaki-lt:#d9b878;
  --gold:#e8b84b; --line:rgba(238,231,216,0.14);
  padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px); padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
  box-sizing:border-box;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-padding-top:70px; scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:var(--deep);color:var(--ink);font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;line-height:1.5;overflow-x:hidden}

img{max-width:100%;display:block}

a{color:inherit}

.btn:active{transform:scale(.97)}
.btn-gold{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold),var(--khaki-lt));color:#1b1206}
.btn-gold:hover{opacity:.92}
.btn-ghost{border-color:var(--line);color:var(--ink)}

nav{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;backdrop-filter:blur(10px);background:rgba(8,20,24,.75);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
.navrow{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:14px 24px;max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-weight:700;font-size:19px;letter-spacing:.2px}
.brand .tag{color:var(--khaki-lt);font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-size:13px;border:1px solid var(--line);padding:3px 9px;border-radius:100px}
.navlinks{display:flex;gap:26px;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--ink-dim)}
.navlinks a{text-decoration:none}
.navlinks a:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.navcta{display:flex;gap:10px}

.hero{position:relative;min-height:88vh;display:flex;align-items:flex-end}
.hero-img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:60% 40%}
.hero-fade{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(8,16,20,.15) 0%,rgba(8,16,20,.35) 45%,rgba(8,16,20,.96) 100%)}
.hero-inner{position:relative;padding:0 24px 64px;max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto;width:100%}
.eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:rgba(15,38,46,.7);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:6px 14px;border-radius:100px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--teal-lt);margin-bottom:22px}
.eyebrow b{color:var(--gold)}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(52px,11vw,124px);font-weight:900;line-height:.92;margin:0 0 18px;color:var(--ink)}
.hero h1 span{color:var(--khaki-lt)}
.hero p.sub{max-width:520px;font-size:18px;color:var(--ink-dim);margin:0 0 30px}
.hero-cta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;align-items:center}
.ca-chip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:rgba(15,38,46,.8);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:100px;padding:9px 8px 9px 18px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink-dim)}
.ca-chip code{font-family:monospace;color:var(--ink);max-width:180px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.ca-chip button{background:var(--teal);border:none;color:#081418;font-weight:700;font-size:12.5px;padding:7px 13px;border-radius:100px;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit}
.ca-chip button:hover{background:var(--teal-lt)}

section{padding:88px 0}
.section-head{max-width:600px;margin-bottom:44px}
.kicker{color:var(--khaki-lt);font-weight:700;font-size:14px;margin:0 0 10px}

.quote-section{background:var(--panel);border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.quote-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.85fr 1.15fr;gap:56px;align-items:center}
.quote-grid img{border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 30px 60px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}

.game-wrap{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px;padding:40px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 340px;gap:40px}

.stage{position:relative;aspect-ratio:1/1;width:100%;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line);touch-action:none;background:#081418}
.stage-img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;user-select:none;-webkit-user-drag:none}
.stage-mask{position:absolute;inset:0;clip-path:polygon(52.25% 36.72% 50.39% 38.57% 50.39% 41.89% 59.96% 56.15% 57.52% 66.31% 58.01% 75.98% 53.61% 75.20% 54.49% 72.36% 53.81% 67.77% 51.66% 65.72% 48.34% 65.43% 46.29% 66.50% 44.53% 69.04% 44.43% 74.22% 42.77% 77.15% 43.16% 79.30% 47.46% 81.54% 61.33% 84.08% 66.02% 88.38% 66.60% 92.09% 69.73% 94.63% 74.51% 95.31% 78.22% 94.43% 84.28% 89.26% 83.98% 86.72% 80.86% 83.69% 85.06% 76.17% 87.01% 67.48% 86.62% 58.20% 84.08% 50.98% 80.47% 46.68% 75.00% 44.53% 81.54% 40.33% 81.93% 36.43% 78.12% 33.89% 71.48% 33.11% 63.48% 34.18% 56.64% 37.30%);-webkit-clip-path:polygon(52.25% 36.72% 50.39% 38.57% 50.39% 41.89% 59.96% 56.15% 57.52% 66.31% 58.01% 75.98% 53.61% 75.20% 54.49% 72.36% 53.81% 67.77% 51.66% 65.72% 48.34% 65.43% 46.29% 66.50% 44.53% 69.04% 44.43% 74.22% 42.77% 77.15% 43.16% 79.30% 47.46% 81.54% 61.33% 84.08% 66.02% 88.38% 66.60% 92.09% 69.73% 94.63% 74.51% 95.31% 78.22% 94.43% 84.28% 89.26% 83.98% 86.72% 80.86% 83.69% 85.06% 76.17% 87.01% 67.48% 86.62% 58.20% 84.08% 50.98% 80.47% 46.68% 75.00% 44.53% 81.54% 40.33% 81.93% 36.43% 78.12% 33.89% 71.48% 33.11% 63.48% 34.18% 56.64% 37.30%);backdrop-filter:blur(15px) saturate(32%) brightness(.5);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(15px) saturate(32%) brightness(.5);background:rgba(6,14,17,.38);transition:opacity .55s ease}
.stage-mask.revealed{opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.stage-outline{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .55s ease}
.stage-outline.revealed{opacity:0}
.stage-outline polygon{fill:rgba(232,184,75,.08);stroke:var(--gold);stroke-width:5;stroke-dasharray:14 10;transition:fill .2s,stroke-width .2s}
.stage-outline.hot polygon{fill:rgba(232,184,75,.2);stroke-width:7}
.dz-label{position:absolute;left:55%;top:32%;transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:12px;color:var(--teal-lt);white-space:nowrap;background:rgba(6,14,17,.7);padding:2px 8px;border-radius:100px;transition:opacity .3s}
.dz-label.hide{opacity:0}
#backpack{position:absolute;left:14px;bottom:14px;width:34%;max-width:150px;cursor:grab;touch-action:none;filter:drop-shadow(0 10px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.6));user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;-webkit-user-drag:none;transition:opacity .35s ease}
#backpack.placed{cursor:default}
#backpack:active{cursor:grabbing}
#backpack.hidden-sprite{opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.confetti{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden}
.confetti i{position:absolute;top:-10px;width:7px;height:11px;opacity:.9;animation:fall 1.6s ease-in forwards}
@keyframes fall{to{transform:translateY(440px) rotate(240deg);opacity:0}}
.game-side{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}
.game-side h3{font-size:24px;margin:0 0 10px}
.game-side p{color:var(--ink-dim);font-size:15.5px;margin:0 0 20px}
#gamemsg{font-size:14.5px;color:var(--teal-lt);min-height:20px;margin-bottom:16px;font-weight:500}
.altbtn{background:none;border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--ink-dim);border-radius:100px;padding:10px 16px;font-size:13.5px;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;width:fit-content}
.altbtn:hover{color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--teal-lt)}

.token-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px}
.token-card{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:22px}
.token-card .lbl{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--khaki-lt);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px}
.token-card .val{font-size:16px;word-break:break-all;font-family:monospace}
.token-card.wide{grid-column:1/-1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
@media(max-width:760px){.token-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

.community{text-align:center}
.community .icon{width:44px;height:44px;margin:0 auto 20px}
.community h2{font-size:clamp(28px,4.5vw,42px);margin:0 0 14px}
.community p{color:var(--ink-dim);max-width:480px;margin:0 auto 30px}

footer{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:36px 0;color:var(--ink-dim);font-size:13px}
.footrow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}
.toast{position:fixed;bottom:24px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(20px);background:var(--gold);color:#1b1206;padding:11px 22px;border-radius:100px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:all .25s ease;z-index:100}
.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}
</style>
</head>

<script>
const CA = "H4ko3yd9V449hNnhEQ3ZRpbRmLdPoeiU8PdhcLYapump";
function copyCA(){
  const done=()=>{const t=document.getElementById('toast');t.classList.add('show');setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('show'),1800);};
  if(navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText){
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(CA).then(done).catch(()=>fallbackCopy(done));
  } else fallbackCopy(done);
}
function fallbackCopy(done){
  const ta=document.createElement('textarea');ta.value=CA;ta.style.position='fixed';ta.style.opacity='0';
  document.body.appendChild(ta);ta.select();
  try{document.execCommand('copy');}catch(e){}
  document.body.removeChild(ta);done();
}

(function(){
  const stage=document.getElementById('stage');
  const bp=document.getElementById('backpack');
  const dz=document.getElementById('dropzone');
  const outline=document.getElementById('outline');
  const dzLabel=document.getElementById('dzLabel');
  const msg=document.getElementById('gamemsg');
  const altBtn=document.getElementById('altEquip');
  const resetBtn=document.getElementById('resetBtn');
  let dragging=false, placed=false, offX=0, offY=0;

  const TARGET_X=0.6847, TARGET_Y=0.6371, TARGET_R=0.2357; // backpack silhouette centroid/radius, as fraction of stage size

  function within(px,py){
    const sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect();
    const cx=TARGET_X*sr.width, cy=TARGET_Y*sr.height, rad=TARGET_R*sr.width;
    return Math.hypot(px-cx,py-cy) < rad;
  }

  bp.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
    if(placed) return;
    dragging=true; bp.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    const sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect(); const br=bp.getBoundingClientRect();
    offX=e.clientX-br.left; offY=e.clientY-br.top;
    bp.style.left=(br.left-sr.left)+'px'; bp.style.top=(br.top-sr.top)+'px';
    bp.style.bottom='auto'; bp.style.right='auto';
    msg.textContent="Now line it up on his back.";
  });
  bp.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{
    if(!dragging) return;
    const sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect();
    let x=e.clientX-sr.left-offX, y=e.clientY-sr.top-offY;
    x=Math.max(-20,Math.min(x,sr.width-bp.offsetWidth+20));
    y=Math.max(-20,Math.min(y,sr.height-bp.offsetHeight+20));
    bp.style.left=x+'px'; bp.style.top=y+'px';
    const hot=within(x+bp.offsetWidth/2,y+bp.offsetHeight/2);
    dz.classList.toggle('hot',hot); outline.classList.toggle('hot',hot);
  });
  bp.addEventListener('pointerup',e=>{
    if(!dragging) return; dragging=false;
    const cx=parseFloat(bp.style.left)+bp.offsetWidth/2, cy=parseFloat(bp.style.top)+bp.offsetHeight/2;
    if(within(cx,cy)) equip(); else{
      bp.style.left='14px'; bp.style.bottom='14px'; bp.style.top='auto';
      dz.classList.remove('hot'); outline.classList.remove('hot');
      msg.textContent="Missed. Line it up with the dashed outline.";
    }
  });

  window.equip=function(){
    placed=true; dragging=false;
    dz.classList.remove('hot'); outline.classList.remove('hot');
    dz.classList.add('revealed'); outline.classList.add('revealed');
    dzLabel.classList.add('hide');
    bp.classList.add('hidden-sprite');
    msg.textContent="Backward Squidward is ready to roll. 🎒";
    altBtn.style.display='none'; resetBtn.style.display='inline-block';
    burst();
  };
  window.resetGame=function(){
    placed=false;
    dz.classList.remove('revealed'); outline.classList.remove('revealed');
    dzLabel.classList.remove('hide');
    bp.classList.remove('hidden-sprite');
    bp.style.left='14px'; bp.style.bottom='14px'; bp.style.top='auto';
    msg.textContent="Waiting for a volunteer...";
    resetBtn.style.display='none'; altBtn.style.display='inline-block';
  };
  function burst(){
    const c=document.getElementById('confetti'); const colors=['#e8b84b','#b6975f','#7fb3ac','#eee7d8'];
    for(let i=0;i<26;i++){
      const s=document.createElement('i');
      s.style.left=(60+Math.random()*22)+'%';
      s.style.background=colors[i%colors.length];
      s.style.animationDelay=(Math.random()*0.3)+'s';
      s.style.top=(28+Math.random()*10)+'%';
      c.appendChild(s);
      setTimeout(()=>s.remove(),2000);
    }
  }
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
